episodes.title: The Bride Price
episodes.summary: The wedding of Sigrid and King Leif ends in tragedy when Thor unleashes his wrath upon the ceremony, sparking a vow of vengeance from the bride-to-be.

episodes.title: Heretic Spear
episodes.summary: In the underworld, Loki sets a plan in motion. Sigrid and Leif recruit a band of warriors and launch a quest for weapons made of god-killing iron.

episodes.title: You Will Gladden His Ravens
episodes.summary: Odin's huntsmen attack Sigrid's crusaders on their treacherous journey to Vanaheim. Thor and his mortal enemy come face to face in combat.

episodes.title: The Worm
episodes.summary: To obtain a bushel of enchanted apples for the Vanir gods, the warriors must bloody their swords in a fight against the beast guarding the orchard.

episodes.title: The Scapegoat God
episodes.summary: Leif and Loki find themselves trapped in a cursed realm. A pack of First Wolves aids the warriors. Sigrid's story attracts surprising new allies.

episodes.title: Now Hear Of...
episodes.summary: On the eve of war, Sigrid and her companions share fantastic tales of magic and honor. Passions ignite around camp, and Odin issues a dire warning.

episodes.title: If I Had a Hammer
episodes.summary: The epic battle begins as mortals, giants and Vanir deities clash swords with Thor and his Aesir soldiers. A risky secret mission ends in bloodshed.

episodes.title: Song of Sigrid
episodes.summary: With the reign of the gods hanging in the balance, legends rise, heroes fall and hidden motives come to light. Odin experiences a shocking revelation.
